prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1442; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the lumbar strain diagnosed at intake. Over the course of 23 visits, treatment followed a conventional progression of manual therapy, guided home exercise, and graded return to activity, and the frequency of visits tapered steadily as symptoms resolved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient reports a remote, small strain to the same region many years ago, which resolved completely without residual limitation and did not require ongoing care. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no repeated charges identified. Current status shows near-full range of motion, minimal tenderness, and independence in daily activities. Continued self-directed exercise is recommended, with follow-up as needed.
